title: orchis × olida var. pauliana
intro: Orchis × olida var. pauliana, commonly known as the Paul's Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species that is a cross between Orchis mascula and Orchis olia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing fever and alleviating coughs. The therapeutic actions of Paul's Orchid are attributed to its ability to exert anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for infections and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
